set_schedule.name: Set weekly schedule range
set_schedule.description: Edit off/economy/comfort slots on exactly one automatic-mode stove. Chrono enablement and targets are preserved. Cloud reads, command and verification can take about 105 seconds, plus up to 20 seconds for refresh and time waiting for queued edits or backup storage. Preview never writes. Only the last 20 backups per stove are retained.

days.name: Weekdays
days.description: Selected weekdays in the saved weekly program.

start.name: Start
start.description: Local whole or half hour, with zero seconds. Split overnight ranges at midnight.

end.name: End (exclusive)
end.description: Local whole or half hour, with zero seconds. 00:00 means the end of the selected day; legacy 24:00 is also accepted in YAML.

preview_only.name: Preview only
preview_only.description: Read the saved schedule and return changes without writing or creating backups.
